ValidationRule.description: For EDU only. When stage is Demo/Building (30%) must enter Root Cause, Symptoms and Impact BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "workato", Not( Account.Account_Region__c = "APAC"), IsClosed = False, RecordType.Name = 'Education', Probability >=0.40, OR( ISBLANK( Root_Cause__c), ISBLANK( Symptoms__c ), ISBLANK( Impact__c ) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: *** Fill in: Root Cause, Symptoms and Impact fields ***
